fusions.name: Turned Furrow
fusions.desc: Lowers your horns and ploughs a furrow 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles. Roots turned up by the furrow leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Close Cropping
fusions.desc: Crops one enemy for 4 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Chew the Cud
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and restores 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Fallow Strength
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you deal 25% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
